channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Kotscho: Esqueletos saem do armário e assombram Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Columnist Ricardo Kotscho states that new revelations involving Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) may not shake his core base but could sway undecided voters in the final stretch of the campaign. The allegations include skeletons brought to light that may impact the candidate's public image.

item.title: Pix cai 10% após proibição das bets, diz Ministério da Justiça
item.description: The federal government reported a 10% drop in Pix transactions after restrictions on illegal betting operations, focusing on financially strangling criminal groups and blocking banking transfers. The task force also blocked thousands of illegal websites, removed social media pages, and ordered the removal of 186 betting apps by October 5th.

item.title: Lula reúne 744 empresários em SP em tentativa de aproximação com setor produtivo
item.description: Lula met with 744 business leaders in São Paulo during a campaign dinner aimed at bridging ties with the productive sector, including major companies like Vale, Itaú, and JBS. Over ten ministers attended to facilitate direct dialogue between the government and entrepreneurs.

item.title: Campanha de Lula acirra busca por indecisos e PT orienta: “Sem briga”
item.description: Lula's campaign intensifies its outreach to undecided voters in the final stretch and instructs supporters to engage without confrontation. The PT's digital guide offers argument scripts for various voter profiles and highlights three central banners: ban on betting, end to 6×1 pricing, and national sovereignty defense.

item.title: Gilmar mantém quebra de sigilo de ex-assessora de Flávio Bolsonaro acusada de ‘rachadinha’
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes upheld the breach of banking and tax secrecy of Danielle da Nóbrega, former aide to Flávio Bolsonaro accused in the 'rachadinha' scheme. The ruling was based on evidence from WhatsApp messages confirming her ghost officeholder status.

item.title: Dino manda Justiça Eleitoral investigar outdoor de loja de roupas
item.description: Supreme Federal Minister Flávio Dino ordered the urgent investigation by the Electoral Justice of the Federal District into an accusation by the PSB that federal deputy Bia Kicis (PL-DF) would have used a R$250,000 amendment for disguised electoral advertising on billboards. The resource was directed to the Viver-Brazil Institute, led by the owner of the Bia Brasil women's fashion store, whose identity is closely linked to the deputy running for the Senate. The investigation also examines suspected misuses of amendments, including in the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Solidariedade pede a Dino que tire poder de Kassio e Mendonça no TSE
item.description: The Solidariedade party filed a lawsuit at the STF requesting that the president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, and vice-president André Mendonça be barred from analyzing electoral advertising cases, alleging a legal violation. The petition was filed after Justice Flávio Dino declared himself the universal judge for TSE cases, a decision later overturned by Minister Luiz Fux, rendering the request theoretically ineffective.

item.title: A última pesquisa Datafolha sobre o 1º turno da eleição presidencial
item.description: Datafolha will release its final poll on voter intent for the first round of the presidential election, surveying 4,006 voters the day before the vote on October 4th. In the previous survey, Lula (PT) led with 40%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 36%, with a technical tie projected for the runoff.

item.title: Vídeo: Disputa pelo Senado tem, em média, seis candidatos por vaga
item.description: Over 300 candidates compete for 54 Senate seats in the 2026 elections, averaging 5.8 candidates per seat. The race varies significantly across states, and the candidates' profile resembles previous elections, with a majority being men and whites. The data comes from the Superior Electoral Court (TSE).

item.title: Crusoé: Lula prova que ninguém precisa de IA para espalhar fake news
item.description: The article analyzes how President Lula demonstrates, without using artificial intelligence, that it is possible to spread fake news during the election campaign, showing that misinformation does not depend solely on advanced technologies.

item.title: Atlas: no Piauí, Lula tem 68,5% das intenções de voto, Flávio 24,9%
item.description: AtlasIntel poll released on 9/29 shows Lula leading with 68.5% of voting intentions in Piauí for the first round, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 24.6%. The survey interviewed 1,218 voters from 9/23 to 9/28, with a margin of error of ±2 percentage points.

item.title: Gilmar mantém quebra de sigilos de ex-assessora de Flávio
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes upheld the disclosure of banking and fiscal records of Danielle da Nóbrega, a former aide to Flávio Bolsonaro, in an investigation involving the senator's office. The ruling was made by the STF's Second Panel.

item.title: Lula fará caminhada em capital de estado considerado crucial para a corrida presidencial
item.description: Lula will hold a campaign walk in Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, two days ahead of the 2026 presidential first round, reinforcing his presence in a historically decisive state. The event includes a public walk with Minas gubernatorial candidate Patrus Ananias across a roughly one-kilometer route connecting Praça da Liberdade and Praça Tiradentes.

item.title: 'Não precisa fazer o L', 'não precisa gostar de mim': Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro buscam votos além de suas bases
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro launched campaigns targeting voters beyond their traditional bases, with speeches aiming to reduce partisan identification. Lula promises to eliminate bets and reduce taxes, while Flávio focuses on security and criticizes previous governments.

item.title: Defesa de Jair Bolsonaro protocola nova revisão criminal e cita impasse no STF
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense filed a new criminal review with the STF, requesting suspension of arrest and conviction in the coup plot case, citing new facts from the September 15 session. Lawyers highlight the ban on self-initiated inquiries and demand time to review evidence.

item.title: Kassio não viu prática criminosa em publicidade de Lula que critica Flávio
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques rejected claims of criminal practice in the Lula and Alckmin campaign ad targeting Flávio Bolsonaro, deeming it a legitimate exercise of political criticism. The ad was temporarily suspended only due to a formal error in displaying the candidates' names.

item.title: Lula liga para Dino no meio de evento no Pará; assista
item.description: President Lula signed, during an event in Pará, the bill creating the National Strategy for Quality Control and Evaluation of Private Healthcare Services, originally proposed by Flávio Dino when he was a senator. During the event, Lula called Dino, then a Supreme Court justice, but the call dropped when asking for the magistrate's input. The president cited the death of Marcelo Dino as motivation for improving medical care.

item.title: Senadores dos EUA cobram que Trump reconheça resultado eleitoral do Brasil
item.description: Democratic U.S. Senators release a letter urging the Trump administration to recognize the outcome of Brazil's 2026 elections, criticizing alleged interference through sanctions and controversial appointments. The lawmakers highlight trade restrictions and Flávio Bolsonaro's meeting with Trump as signs of meddling in Brazil's electoral process.

item.title: Proibição das bets: governo diz que já pediu o bloqueio de mais de 5,2 mil sites e retirada de quase 200 apps de lojas
item.description: The federal government, through the provisional decree banning online betting, announced it has requested the blocking of over 5,200 sites and the removal of 186 betting apps from Apple and Google stores. It also notified social networks and digital platforms to remove irregular content and ads, while President Lula emphasized the fight against family debt and gambling addiction.

item.title: Após Lula, Esfera reúne Romeu Zema com empresários em SP
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) meets with business leaders in São Paulo at an event organized by Esfera Brasil, focusing on economic and political outlooks. The initiative mirrors the same format used by Lula, highlighting plural dialogue between policymakers and the private sector.

item.title: Vice de Zema pede impeachment de Nunes Marques por ligações com Master
item.description: Senator Eduardo Girão, running mate of Romeu Zema, filed an impeachment request against Supreme Court Minister Kassio Nunes Marques over alleged ties to Banco Master, reinforcing the claim that no STF member should be untouchable. Leaked messages suggest the minister's son received R$500,000 from banker Daniel Vorcaro, along with other payments linked to legal services.

item.title: Decisão de Lula de faltar a debate da Globo em 2006 foi vista como erro pela campanha e aliados
item.description: Twenty years ago, Lula chose not to attend a TV Globo debate before the first round of the 2006 elections, a decision viewed as a mistake by both his campaign and PT allies. His absence sparked criticism and internal debate over campaign strategy. The incident remains one of the most discussed moments of that election cycle.

item.title: Nunes Marques reclama de ingerência de Dino no TSE, mas fez o mesmo em 2022
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, complained to the STF about the alleged interference of the Court in electoral cases, after Flávio Dino reversed a TSE decision regarding the removal of a post by comedian Antonio Tabet. In 2022, Nunes Marques had taken a similar stance, questioning the court's interference. The episode underscores the conflict between Powers in the conduct of electoral processes.

item.title: "Mulheres aprendem a tomar toque desde pequenas", diz Lula em comício
item.description: At a rally in Belém (PA), President Lula criticized men's reluctance to undergo prostate exams and praised the robotic surgery advancements in the SUS. He also visited the São João de Deus Hospital and emphasized the importance of overcoming male taboos in healthcare. The main focus was on preventive health and technological progress.

item.title: Nunes Marques diz que Lula fez ataque ‘inconsequente’ à Justiça Eleitoral e manda remover vídeo
item.description: The president of the TSE, Nunes Marques, ordered the removal of a video from a Lula rally where he questioned the possibility of 'fraud' by the electoral court, deeming the speech an 'inconsequential' attack on Electoral Justice. The decision responded to a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, with the measure being temporary and awaiting review by other TSE ministers.

item.title: Atlas projeta ‘goleada’ de Lula sobre Flávio Bolsonaro no Piauí
item.description: An AtlasIntel survey shows President Lula leading by 44 points over Flávio Bolsonaro in Piauí, with 68.5% of voting intentions. The poll, with a two-point margin of error, projects a favorable outcome for Lula in the first round. Other candidates had minimal support.

item.title: DF: Flávio soma 48% contra 40% de Lula no segundo turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data survey published by CartaCapital DF shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading in both the first and second rounds against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). In the first round, Flávio has 40% of voting intentions versus 36% for Lula; in the second round, the lead widens to 48% against 40%.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: A guerra Santa no STF; Fux dá aula de Direito a Flávio Dino
item.description: The program Meio-Dia em Brasília discusses a judicial dispute at the STF related to news about Nossa Senhora Aparecida and the campaigns of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT), highlighting exchanges of criticism between justices and politicians. The episode includes a 'law lesson' given by Justice Fux to Flávio Dino, intensifying the institutional conflict.

item.title: Nossa Senhora, por enquanto, não intercedeu por Lula
item.description: Lula's campaign spread a fake news claiming Flávio Bolsonaro intended to remove Nossa Senhora Aparecida's title as Brazil's patron saint, using religion as a political weapon. The false story targeted religious groups and social media, condemned for reviving a polarizing tactic.

item.title: PGR não vê crime em frase de deputado do PL sobre Flávio Dino
item.description: The PGR (Attorney General's Office) determined that no crime was committed in a statement by federal deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO) about Minister Flávio Dino, requesting the case's dismissal. The rapporteur, Minister Cármen Lúcia, had asked the PGR to evaluate Gayer's remarks, made while criticizing Dino's role at the STF. Nonetheless, Gayer remains under indictment for insulting President Lula and racism.

item.title: Fux é o ministro que absolve golpistas, mas que é implacável com humoristas
item.description: Minister Luiz Fux faced backlash for reviving censorship on social media posts, overriding a decision by Minister Flávio Dino to restore content removed by the TSE. The conflict involved preemptive censorship against comedians and critics, sparking debates on freedom of expression and judicial overreach.

item.title: Governo prorroga o Desenrola Adimplentes na reta final para o 1º turno
item.description: The federal government extended the Desenrola Adimplentes program for an additional 30 days, targeting informal workers with debts up to R$ 15,000. The extension, announced near the first electoral round, was justified by operational delays in the program's implementation.

item.title: Religiões de matriz africana também precisam ocupar o espaço da política
item.description: Religion has increasingly entered the Brazilian electoral debate, yet Afro-Brazilian religions remain underrepresented in politics despite their demographic relevance and vulnerability to religious intolerance. The dominance of Christian voices in the political arena contrasts with the lack of adequate representation for traditional communities such as Umbanda and Candomblé practitioners.

item.title: Após desistência, Salles chama Derrite para evento de campanha em sua casa
item.description: After withdrawing from the Senate race, Ricardo Salles hosted around 200 female opinion leaders at his home in São Paulo to reinforce support for Guilherme Derrite, who is running for Senate on Tarcísio de Freitas's slate. The meeting aimed to maintain momentum and consolidate alliances on the right following Salles' exit from the race.

item.title: Flávio liga para Salles e agradece por desistência ao Senado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), presidential candidate, called Ricardo Salles (Novo) to thank him for withdrawing from the Senate race in São Paulo. Salles announced his exit from the race on the morning of the 28th, and according to close sources, Flávio praised the former minister's gesture. The call takes place amid political alignment between the two figures.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula participa de ato de campanha em Fortaleza
item.description: President Lula participated in a campaign rally in Fortaleza alongside Ceará Governor Elmano de Freitas, both running for re-election with the PT. The event is part of Lula's Northeast tour ahead of the first round of elections. After Ceará, Lula traveled to Salvador for a walk with Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues.

item.title: Van Hattem, Sanderson e Manuela empatam em disputa ao Senado no RS
item.description: A Real Time Big Data poll released on September 29, 2026, shows a tight race between Marcel Van Hattem (23%), Sanderson (19%), and Manuela D'ávila (18%) for the first Senate seat in Rio Grande do Sul, with Paulo Pimenta (16%) trailing. The survey, which interviewed 1,600 voters from September 24 to 28, has a 2-point margin of error and was filed with the TSE under number RS-05412/2026 at a cost of $20,000 funded by TV Record.

item.title: Brasil seguir nacionalismo de Trump seria ruim para o mundo, diz Piketty à BBC
item.description: French economist Thomas Piketty warned the BBC that if Brazil follows a nationalist path similar to Donald Trump's, it would be harmful to the world, particularly regarding inequality and economic policies. He compared today's global situation to conditions that led to the French Revolution, emphasizing the risk of a super-rich elite exploiting poorer populations. His statement highlights concerns about the direction of the global economy and rising nationalism.

item.title: Una noticia falsa sobre la virgen de Aparecida, patrona de Brasil, marca el final de la campaña presidencial
item.description: A false news involving the Virgem of Aparecida, patron saint of Brazil, stirs the 2026 election campaign and sparks controversy, with statements from Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, alongside reactions from the Episcopal Conference and the Supreme Court. The misinformation may influence voters in a deeply polarized electoral scenario.

item.title: Reforma tributária elevará exportações em 17%, diz Alckmin
item.description: Vice-president Geraldo Alckmin stated that the tax reform could increase Brazilian exports by 17% over 15 years, according to an Ipea study. The reform will replace five taxes with a dual VAT, reducing tax cumulativity and exempting investments and exports starting in 2027.

item.title: Sociedade civil rebate Anatel sobre internet grátis na eleição
item.description: 12 civil society organizations requested the Supreme Federal Court to join as amici curiae a lawsuit seeking unrestricted mobile internet access during elections, challenging Anatel's claims of traffic spikes. They question the agency's lack of concrete data on the real impact of this measure and cite European examples like TikTok in Romania. The lawsuit, filed by CNTE and PV, aims to ensure universal access to electoral information and combat disinformation on private platforms.

item.title: OEA enviará autoridades de outros países para acompanhar votação no Brasil no próximo domingo
item.description: The Organization of American States (OAS) will send a delegation of authorities from countries such as Chile, Paraguay, and Uruguay to observe the upcoming election in Brazil on Sunday. The mission aims to gather diverse perspectives on the electoral process and produce reports with conclusions and recommendations. The Superior Electoral Court has also invited other international bodies, including the European Union and the Mercosul Parliament, to serve as observers.

item.title: Dino manda TRE-DF analisar suposta propaganda da loja ‘Bia Brasil’ a favor de Bia Kicis
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the Electoral Court to investigate alleged irregular advertising by 'Bia Brasil' store in favor of Bia Kicis, following a complaint by the Socialism and Liberty Party.

item.title: Quem são todos os candidatos a governador de Minas Gerais (MG) nas eleições 2026
item.description: Party conventions on August 5 officially confirmed the 11 candidates for governor of Minas Gerais in 2026, following Romeu Zema's resignation. Key names include acting governor Mateus Simões (PSD) seeking reelection, while the Bolsonaro right splits between Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) and Flávio Roscoe (PL). Other candidates are Patrus Ananias (PT), Ben Mendes (Missão), and Gabriel Azevedo (MDB), with elections set for October 4.

item.title: Quando a liberdade de uma mulher vira argumento contra a liberdade das outras
item.description: The article examines how some female influencers use their freedom of speech to attack women's suffrage, confusing personal choice with the suppression of other women's rights. This historically defeated rhetoric resurfaces as a seemingly legitimate political proposal, threatening gender equality in Brazil. The normalization of extreme ideas demands democratic vigilance.

item.title: Em vez de propostas, eleição presidencial chega na reta final discutindo religião e STF entra na briga
item.description: The 2026 election campaign enters the final stretch of the first round with debates focused on religion and STF interventions in the TSE, rather than substantive proposals. Fake news involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Our Lady of Aparecida triggered legal battles between STF and TSE, with Fachin criticizing ministers like Dino and Mendonça. The scenario reflects institutional polarization and erosion of the Electoral Justice during the vote.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado federal Rio de Janeiro (RJ) 2026: veja lista com nomes e números para votar
item.description: The list of candidates for federal deputy in Rio de Janeiro for 2026 is available with names and voting numbers. Voters will be able to choose representatives for the Chamber of Deputies starting in 2027. The data was updated on September 28, 2026.

item.title: “Ninguém vai avacalhar com Nossa Senhora Aparecida”, diz Lula
item.description: Lula stated during a rally in Belém that no one will disrespect Our Lady of Aparecida while he is president, criticizing pastor André Valadão. He also called for investigations into Daniel Vorcaro and denied any intent to remove the title of patron saint. Flávio Bolsonaro denied involvement in the alleged fake news about removing the devotion, attributing it to the PT.

item.title: Análise: Lula e Flávio dão sinais de que eleição não terminará nas urnas
item.description: The campaigns of Lula and Flávio show signs that the 2026 election may not be decided by the ballot box, with both sides preparing arguments to challenge the result. Lula may invoke alleged U.S. interference, while Flávio is also positioned to question the election's legitimacy.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP nesta terça (29/9)
item.description: Six candidates compete for the São Paulo governorship in 2026, with Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad leading the polls. On Tuesday (September 29), candidates follow campaign schedules including TV debates, metro flyer distribution, and podcasts. The election race enters the final stretch with only six days remaining before the first round.
